findings.title: security.md understates the reach of gh's token
findings.cause: the subsection "ai-ctl Itself" gives gh's token the scope `repo` alone, where `gh auth login` with SSH as git protocol granted `repo`, `read:org`, `gist` and `admin:public_key`
findings.consequence: a reader weighing what code run as the user gains from the keyring misses that the token can add an SSH key to the account, a way back in that outlives the key in the agent
findings.fix: name the four scopes, `admin:public_key` coming from the login's offer to upload an SSH key and removable with `gh auth refresh --remove-scopes admin:public_key`, the three others gh's minimum
findings.test: none: a document; its proof is `gh auth status`'s scopes line against the text
findings.evidence: reproduced: `gh auth status` on 2026-11-06 prints "Token scopes: 'admin:public_key', 'gist', 'read:org', 'repo'"; `gh auth refresh --help` of gh 2.97.0 says the minimum set, `repo`, `read:org` and `gist`, cannot be removed
findings.fixed_in: docs(security): name every scope of gh's token
